Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

PhysioEMG 0.2.5

  • Time-varying (convolutive) muscle synergies (R/emg-convolutive.R): convolutiveSynergy() extracts shift-invariant muscle x time spatiotemporal synergy templates by convolutive NMF (d’Avella & Bizzi 2003; Smaragdis 2004) — the temporal-structure complement to spatial NMF and the trial-mode tensor.

PhysioEMG 0.2.4

  • Non-negative tensor factorisation of muscle synergies (R/emg-tensor.R):
    • muscleSynergyTensor() — non-negative CANDECOMP/PARAFAC of a muscle x time x trial EMG tensor (each synergy = muscle weights x temporal profile x per-trial loading), the multiway generalisation of spatial-NMF muscle synergies.
    • muscleSynergyTensorOrder() — VAF-threshold selection of the synergy count.

PhysioEMG 0.2.3

  • Documentation: the emg-analysis vignette now envelopes the MVC reference trial before MVC amplitude normalization, so both the working data and the reference carry the "envelope" assay that emgAmplitudeNormalize() reads. The vignette now runs clean. No functional change to the package.

PhysioEMG 0.2.2

  • emgEnvelope() now records a W3C-PROV provenance activity (via the shared .recordProv helper, matching the PhysioPreprocess pattern), so the envelope step is visible to the reproducibility substrate’s run-tracing. No change to the computed envelope.

PhysioEMG 0.2.1

Bug fixes

  • emgOnsetDetect() now applies the rectify-and-smooth conditioning of the published methods before thresholding: the rectified signal (“hodges_bui”) or rectified Teager-Kaiser trace (“teager_kaiser”) is smoothed with a centered moving average controlled by the new smooth_ms argument (default 25 ms, in the 10–50 ms range examined by Hodges & Bui 1996; smooth_ms = 0 restores the previous behavior). Previously the threshold was applied to the unsmoothed rectified trace, which dips below threshold at every carrier zero-crossing, so contiguous suprathreshold runs almost never reached min_duration_ms and both threshold methods failed to detect genuine band-limited bursts (zero detections at SNR 20 dB); the statistical “bonato” and “aglr” detectors were unaffected.

PhysioEMG 0.2.0

Initial release as a standalone package in the x-biosignal ecosystem, split from the PhysioExperiment monorepo. PhysioEMG provides electromyography (EMG) analysis for PhysioExperiment objects, spanning amplitude, timing, spectral fatigue, muscle synergy, and inter-muscular network methods.

New Features

  • Amplitude analysis:
    • emgEnvelope() extracts the amplitude envelope via sliding-window RMS (O(1) prefix-sum implementation), the Hilbert analytic signal, or rectification with a moving-average lowpass filter.
    • emgAmplitudeNormalize() normalizes amplitude to maximum voluntary contraction (MVC) or within-trial peak.
  • Muscle activation timing:
    • emgOnsetDetect() detects activation onsets and offsets using the Hodges-Bui baseline-SD threshold or the Teager-Kaiser energy operator, with a minimum-duration gate to reject spurious bursts.
  • Spectral fatigue analysis:
    • emgFatigue() tracks windowed median and mean frequency plus RMS amplitude to characterize myoelectric fatigue.
    • emgFatigueIndex() summarizes fatigue as the final-to-initial median frequency ratio.
    • emgSpectralMoments() computes spectral moments (M0, M1, M2) over sliding windows.
  • Muscle synergy decomposition:
    • muscleSynergy() factorizes multi-channel EMG into synergies via NMF, PCA, or ICA, reporting weight and activation matrices with variance-accounted-for (VAF).
    • synergyReconstruct() rebuilds signals from a chosen number of synergies, and synergyCompare() best-match pairs and correlates two synergy solutions.
  • Inter-muscular network analysis:
    • Static connectivity via emgCoherenceNetwork() (Welch magnitude-squared coherence), emgPartialCoherenceNetwork() (partial coherence from the inverse cross-spectral matrix), and emgWPLINetwork() (weighted phase-lag index, with an optional debiased estimator).
    • Directed connectivity via emgDirectedGCNetwork() using pairwise Granger causality (F-statistic or delta-R-squared scoring, with p-values).
    • Time-varying connectivity via emgDynamicWaveletNetwork() using Morlet wavelet coherence in sliding windows with cone-of-influence masking.
    • emgCoordinationStructure() summarizes network topology (module detection, weighted modularity, efficiency, clustering, participation and within-module z-scores).
    • emgInterpretNetworkKG() ranks and annotates high-weight edges with optional node metadata and knowledge-graph links.
  • Synthetic data generators for examples and testing: make_emg(), make_emg_contraction(), and make_emg_fatigue().

Bug Fixes

  • Corrected the RMS envelope computation in emgEnvelope() for accurate windowed amplitude estimates.
